subject: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs
messages:
From: Sam Carter <scarter@strataai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for offering to host us at Redwood HQ for the product walkthrough. We’re finalizing travel for our two engineers and would like to confirm logistics so the visit goes smoothly. Attendees: Elena Park (frontend) and Michael Huang (ML infra).

Quick questions:
- Do visitors need to sign an NDA ahead of time? I attached our completed visitor badge form (Visitor_badge_form.pdf) — does Redwood need a different form?
- Parking & arrival: are there guest parking passes we should request? Arrival ETA is 9:00 AM on Thursday, May 20.
- Conference room / AV: we’ll bring one laptop for a live demo and may need HDMI + adaptor. Will a projector and HDMI cable be available?
- Is there a preferred hotel you recommend within walking distance? We’ve blocked a room for now but can adapt.

If you want to loop in facilities or IT now, feel free — I’d like to lock this down by tomorrow. Also, please add Priya (cc’d) to the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Carter | Head of Platform Partnerships
StrataAI
scarter@strataai.com

Attachment: Visitor_badge_form.pdf
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Sam Carter <scarter@strataai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs

Hi Sam — great to hear. Looking forward to hosting Elena and Michael. Notes and actions below: 

Schedule (proposed)
- 09:00 — Visitor arrival & badge pickup at main lobby (we’ll meet them)
- 09:30 — Coffee and quick intro with product & CS (Orchid 2A)
- 10:00 — Demo (Orchid 2A) to ~12:00; 12:00-13:00 lunch with engineering leads

Security / NDA
- We require a simple visitor NDA for demos involving internal test data. I’m sending a DocuSign link for Redwood’s standard one — please sign by EOD Wednesday so security can pre-clear badges. Link: https://www.docusign.com/contract/abc123-strata-nda
- If you prefer to bring your signed company NDA, that’s fine; security still needs the signed badge form 48 hours prior.

Logistics / AV / IT
- We’ll provide HDMI + USB-C adapters and a small wireless presenter. If you need direct network access to an internal sandbox, IT will stand up a temporary VPN token for the visit (details below from Mina).
- Parking: we’ll reserve two guest passes for three hours at the visitor lot adjacent to Building B. I’ll confirm license plate or pickup arrangements once you confirm vehicle info.

Lodging
- Recommended hotels: Novato Inn (5 min drive) or Harborview Suites (10 min walk). If you want, I can share a preferred rate code.

Next steps for you
1) Sign the DocuSign NDA (link above).
2) Return the completed Visitor_badge_form with full legal names, DOB last 4, and driver license/license plate if driving.
3) Confirm any AV or data needs (SSH access, OS versions, etc.).

I’ll add a calendar placeholder for Thursday and update once we confirm.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Sam Carter <scarter@strataai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Venkataraman <priya.venk@strataai.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs

Thanks Karthik — I signed the DocuSign NDA this morning (confirmation attached as DocuSign_StrataAI_NDA-link.txt). I’m attaching our hotel reservation stub as well (Hotel_reservation_stub.pdf).

A couple of clarifications:
- We’ll bring one MacBook Pro (M1, macOS 13) and one Linux laptop (Ubuntu 22.04). We may need to mount an internal S3 bucket and demonstrate a short live pipeline that calls your hosted API (no production data).
- Do you need any SSH keys ahead of time, or can we generate tokens once we’re on the guest network?
- Lunch: Elena is vegetarian; Michael is allergic to shellfish.

I added Priya (product) to the thread and asked her to accept the calendar invite once you send it.

—Sam

Attachment: Hotel_reservation_stub.pdf, DocuSign_StrataAI_NDA-link.txt
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Sam Carter <scarter@strataai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T12:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs

Hi Sam — Mina from IT here. Quick tech/process notes so the demo goes smoothly: 

Networking / Access
- We don’t require SSH keys ahead of time. For sandbox access we’ll provision a one-time demo token and place the environment behind a demo VLAN. Ethan will generate the VPN token onsite at check-in and hand it to your attendees.
- Please confirm the two laptop OS versions (you already noted macOS 13 and Ubuntu 22.04 — that’s fine). If you need Docker access or specific ports opened, list them now.

AV / Room setup
- Orchid 2A has HDMI, USB-C, and an AppleTV for AirPlay. We’ll bring adapters but if you have any special dongles please bring them. 

Facilities / Badging
- Security requires the signed visitor badge form 48 hours before arrival. If badges aren’t cleared, we can still host but arrival may include a 20–30 minute lobby verification.

Ethan (cc’d) will coordinate projector test at 08:45 on Thursday and will be onsite for the first hour.

—Mina
Mina Haddad | IT Ops | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Sam Carter <scarter@strataai.com>

Subject: Re: StrataAI HQ in-person demo — visitor credentials, lodging, and AV needs

All set — Elena and Michael confirmed flight times (arrive 8:30 AM). DocuSign shows signed; badge form attached. We do not need SSH keys in advance — please issue the demo token onsite to Michael. Lunch requests noted (vegetarian + shellfish allergy).

I accepted the calendar event (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=0example_strata_demo) and added Priya. See you Thursday — I’ll bring the two laptops and a spare USB-C hub.

Best,
Sam
